method: Jaccard and containment of normalised stem tokens against each heading of the dump README; stop words removed; tokens under 3 chars dropped
method_2026_11_07: scripts/audit_overlap.py: normalised tokens (case-folded, punctuation stripped, stop words and tokens under 3 characters dropped); Jaccard = |A∩B|/|A∪B|, containment = |A∩B|/|A| where A is the audited stem. Flagged at Jaccard >= 0.30 or containment >= 0.55. Reference text is kept locally, never committed.
